CONSENT CALENDAR
Approve Amendment No. 4 to Agreement No. CS-203.A, Wastewater and Stormwater Technical Services, with CH2M Hill and Avila Associates
Approve Amendment No. 2 to Agreement No. CS-203.C, Wastewater and Stormwater Technical Services, with F.E. Jordan Associates, Inc.

Approve the selection of Catalyst Consulting Group, Inc. (Catalyst) and Guidepost Solutions LLC (Guidepost); award Agreement Nos. PRO.0072.A-B, Security Consulting and Design Services
Approve the plans and specifications, and award Contract No. WD-2811, 8-Inch and 16-Inch Ductile Iron Water Main Replacement on 17th Street from Clayton Street to Douglass Street
Approve the plans and specifications, and award Contract No. WW-677, Various Locations Sewer Replacement No. 6, in the amount of $4,240,437
Adopt a Resolution authorizing the General Manager to execute a Second Amendment to the employment contract for the position of Assistant General Manager for Infrastructure
Approve the selection of HDR Engineering, Inc. (HDR) and AECOM Technical Services, Inc. (AECOM); award Agreements Nos. PRO.0138A & C
Approve the plans and specifications, and award Contract No. WD-2739, Pavement Renovation, Sewer Replacement, and Water Main Replacement on Castro Street and 26th Street, in the amount of $14,919,291
Approve the plans and specifications, and award Contract No. WW-687, Force Main Rehabilitation at Embarcadero and Jackson, in the amount of $5,986,222
Conditionally approve the issuance of up to $3,065,395,000, inclusive of the proposed $2,500,000,000 acquisition cost

Retroactively authorize the Assistant General Manager of the Water Enterprise to apply for a California Climate Investments Fire Protection Grant from the California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection
Approve the Water Supply Assessment for the proposed One Vassar Project to construct new buildings at 400 Second Street and 657 Harrison Street
Approve the terms and conditions of, and authorize the General Manager to execute, a no-fee, five-year revocable license to replace an existing license with Tuolumne County
